key_claims: This chunk contains only front matter, a table of contents and redacted pages, so no substantive claims about the network can be extracted.

The table of contents lists a Taliban homepage, a Bin Ladin press representative (Khalid Al-Fawwaz), Abu Hajer (Mamdouh Mahmud Salim) and Saudi dissident Mohammed Al Massari as figures or topics in later pages.
Information cutoff date for the assessment is 11 July 1999.
Bin Ladin's 1996 Declaration of War was disseminated in Arabic and English via the CDLR fax network run by Saudi dissident Mohammed Al Masari in London.
Bin Ladin maintained London-based media (Khalid Al-Fawwaz) and technology (Mamdouh Mahmud Salim) representatives.
The Taliban maintained a web homepage, part of the online information environment around Afghanistan-based jihadists.
Bin Ladin's chronology: Afghanistan 1979, Sudan 1991, expelled from Khartoum and returned to Afghanistan in 1996, fatwa Feb 1998, embassy bombings Aug 1998.
